花市的一天(A Day at the flower market): 围绕自然环境的A1短文:介绍安娜的日常、喜好与花市。
After school, we play together. We often go to the museum together. My friend Sam is very kind. The bear caught a fish in the river.
The flower market is not far from my home. Anna wants to visit Toronto. I like my life very much. Best of all, it often rains in April.
Anna usually eats noodles for lunch. Sam likes noodles too. Sam often helps me with science.
